_readme: Copy this file to data/gcal-feeds.json and put the REAL secret address in `url`.
Get it from your calendar provider: in Google Calendar it is Settings -> the
calendar in the left column -> Integrate calendar -> 'Secret address in iCal
format'. It is a BEARER SECRET: anyone holding it can read that calendar forever.
src/connectors/gcal-sync.mjs never logs it, never puts it in argv, never writes it
into data/gcal-items.json or the payload, and src/drive-bundle.mjs refuses to
mirror gcal-feeds.json to Drive. If it ever leaks, click 'Reset' next to the
secret address on that same settings page and paste the new one here.
Direction is inbound only: nothing in this repository ever writes to a calendar.
Check the file with `node src/connectors/gcal-sync.mjs --validate`, which prints
ids and hosts only. The route also needs calendars.gcal.enabled = true in
config.json; see docs/connectors/calendar-feeds.md.
id             [a-z0-9-]{1,24}, unique, and not a reserved prefix ('fb' is
refused - it already names study sessions). Prefixes every
meeting key.
label          shown on the page, 24 characters or fewer. Omit it and the feed
whose id matches calendars.gcal.feed takes calendars.gcal.label;
any other feed is labelled with its own id.
url            https only. An empty url means 'not set up yet' and is a clean
skip, not an error.
skipUidSuffix  optional, per feed. Overrides calendars.gcal.skipUidSuffix: events
whose UID ends with it were put on that calendar by this agenda's
own ICS sink, so they are dropped instead of being drawn twice.
Set it to "" to switch that guard off for one feed.
